 : JUDGMENT :
The PSI, Rajajinagar Police Station has submitted the present charge sheet against the accused No.1 and 2 for the offences punishable U/Sec.498A, 506 of IPC.
2.

The brief facts of the prosecution case is as follows:
That the accused No.1 is the husband of Cw1 and their marriage was took place on 21.01.2013 and after the marriage when Cw1 was residing with accused No.1 and 2 in her matrimonial home, the accused No.1 and 2 have subjected Cw1 to physical and mental torture and also threatened do away her life.

As such Cw1 lodged a complaint as per Ex.P.1.
3.
A Case is registered in Rajajinagar Police Station as Crime No.47/2021 for the offences punishable under Section 498A, 506 of IPC.
After completion of investigation charge sheet has been filed against the accused No.1 and 2 for the above said offences and this court has taken cognizance for the above said offences.
4. The accused No.1 and 2 appeared through their counsel and they have been enlarged on bail.
Prosecution papers were furnished to accused No.1 and 2 as required under Section 207 of Criminal Procedure Code.

Heard both sides, charge has been framed, read over and explained the contents to accused No.1 and 2 in the language known to them, wherein the accused No.1 and 2 pleaded not guilty and claims to be tried.
5. In order to prove the case of the prosecution, it has examined 01 witness as PW-1 and got marked Ex.P-1 to Ex.P-4 document.

After completion of prosecution evidence statement of accused No.1 and 2 as required under Section 313 of Criminal Procedure Code is recorded, read over and explained to accused No.1 and 2 in the language known to them, wherein the accused No.1 and 2 denied the incriminating evidence appeared against them but they have not choosen to lead any evidence from their side.

6. Heard arguments and perused the material on record.
7.

The following points that arise for my consideration:
Deepa C vs V.N Thyagaraj on 14 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43523518/
2 1. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubts that he accused No.1 is the husband of Cw1 and their marriage was took place on 21.01.2013 and after the marriage when Cw1 was residing with accused No.1 and 2 in her matrimonial home,
the accused No.1 and 2 have subjected Cw1 to physical and mental torture and also threatened do away her life, as such they have committed offences punishable U/s.498A, 506 of IPC?

8. My answer to the above points are as follows:
Point No.1 : In the Negative Point No.2 : As per the final Order.

for the following:
REASONS 9. Point No.1: It is the case of the prosecution that, he accused No.1 is the husband of Cw1 and their marriage was took place on 21.01.2013 and after the marriage when Cw1 was residing with accused No.1 and 2 in her matrimonial home, the accused No.1 and 2 have subjected Cw1 to physical and mental torture and also threatened do away her life.
10. According to the prosecution Pw1 is the complainant/ victim.
The prosecution has produced and got marked Ex.P-1 is the complaint, Ex.P.2 and Ex.P.3 are the panchanamas, Ex.P.4 is the further statement of Pw1.

12 . In support of the case of prosecution it has examined Cw1 / Smt. Deepa examined as Pw1, who deposed before the court that the accused No.1 is her husband, accused no.2 is the sister of accused no.1 and the marriage of accused no.1 with Cw1 took place on 18.01.2013 at Kumbakonam.

The witness further stated that they have given cash of Rs.3,00,000/- and gold ornaments weighing 320 grams to the accused No.1 and after the marriage the accused No.1 and 2 have subjected her to physical and mental torture, but in further chief examination of Cw1, the complainant deposed before the court that the accused No.1 has not received any dowry from her forcibly, the accused persons have not subjected her to physical nor mental torture, the accused No.1 has not lie before her regarding his education, the accused persons have not quarreled with her nor abused her nor threatened her.
She put her signature to a complaint prepared by the police.
She do not know the contents of complaint.
The police have obtained her signatures to Ex.P.2 and Ex.P.3 panchanama in the police station.
No panchanama was conducted in her presence.
She has not given any further statement to the police.

13. It is pertinent to note that even though the complainant in her chief examination initially supported the case of the prosecution, but subsequently in her chief examination itself she has deposed before the court that, the accused No.1 has not received any dowry from her forcibly, the accused persons have not subjected her to physical nor mental torture, the accused No.1 has not lie
Deepa C vs V.N Thyagaraj on 14 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43523518/
3 before her regarding his education, the accused persons have not quarreled with her nor abused her nor threatened her.
She put her signature to a complaint prepared by the police.
She do not know the contents of complaint.
The police have obtained her signatures to Ex.P.2 and Ex.P.3 panchanama in the police station.
No panchanama was conducted in her presence.
She has not given any further statement to the police.

As the complainant herself admitted before the court that the accused persons have not subjected her to physical or mental torture nor threatened to do away her life, as such the prosecution failed to prove the guilt of the accused persons beyond all reasonable doubt.
Hence, answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
14. Point No.2:

In view of my findings on Point No.1 in the Negative, I proceed to pass the following:
:ORDER:
Acting under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C accused No.1 and 2 are hereby acquitted for the offence punishable under Section 498A, 506 of IPC.
Their bail bonds and surety bonds stands cancelled.
(Dictated to the Stenographer directly on computer, typed by her, corrected and then pronounced by me in the open Court on this 14th day of February 2024 ).
(Vijeth .V) XXXIX ACMM, Bengaluru.
